data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 观星甲板】深夜平静的罗德岛观景甲板上，艾雅法拉仰起清秀的小脸凝望着漫天闪烁的浩瀚星斗，微风吹拂着她单薄的外套。她往你身边靠了靠轻声说道——「虽然我的眼睛在变暗、耳朵也渐渐听不清大地的声音……但只要握着前辈的手，我就能感受到这世上全部的温暖。」
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla looks up at the star field on Rhodes Island's observation deck, leaning beside her clothed companion as her hand finds theirs. Dark-green and cream country dress, wool shawl and beret retain the outfit; the picnic basket rests near the deck seat. The medium-wide view includes their separate figures and receding rail. Dim deck lamps warm the joined hands, while starlight softly outlines her shawl against the open night sky.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 观星甲板
